mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, we are seeing overcast skies with a temperature of 68 degrees, though it feels a bit warmer at 71 degrees near City Hall. We are currently in the Third Quarter moon phase.

The City of Verona has launched a new tri-shaw bike program, allowing residents to book free 30-minute rides on the Military Ridge State Trail. Additionally, the Rec Department is currently hiring seasonal help, including adult fitness instructors.

There is plenty to do, including the Downtown Farmers Market happening today at Hometown Junction Park and Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory. Tomorrow, be sure to head over to Century School Park for the free Concerts in the Park series.
Looking at the weekly report, on July 28, an officer located an occupied vehicle in Fireman Park after closing hours, which resulted in an arrest due to an outstanding warrant.
Culver is is currently closed, but they open their doors at 10 AM. Today, you can enjoy the delicious Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie flavor, and tomorrow the flavor will be Chocolate Caramel Twist.
